name: Astral Wizards
summary: Astral Wizards is a roguelike survivor game in neon pixel art for mobile, designed for one-handed portrait play. The player only controls movement while weapons attack automatically. Defeating monsters grants experience; each level-up offers a choice of new weapons, passives or upgrades, and pairing a weapon with the right passive evolves it into a stronger form. The game features 18 weapons with evolutions, 9 playable wizards with their own starting weapons and traits, and 10 cosmic worlds, each with its own enemies, hazards, music and a boss that appears at the 10-minute mark. Gold earned in runs is spent on permanent upgrades, new weapons and wizards, and cosmetic skins.
